question: Does explicitly requesting Priority on the preserved generateContent route permit a complete conforming answer, and what service tier does the provider report?
hypothesis: The documented Priority tier can reduce capacity rejection while retaining the frozen answer contract. Up to five sequential attempts are authorized; this is an operational repair check, not a reliability estimate or isolated causal test.
disconfirming_result: Any provider rejection, incomplete capture, negative answer conformance, reported downgrade, conflicting tier reports, or absent tier reports fails the corresponding acquisition, answer or Priority-routing acceptance. No resend.

bounds.expiry: Each fresh run expires six hours after its enrollment, before 2027-01-01T00:00:00Z. Each historical or completed run remains closed.
bounds.stopping_rule: Stop this batch on the first complete answer capture, regardless of conformance or serving-tier result. After a fully retained 503 and reconciled durable completion, close that run, wait 30 seconds and prepare the next distinct run. No resend, call-key reuse, concurrent requests, route fallback, or retry after an ambiguous transport result. Stop batch at five total calls or USD2.50 reserved; any later batch requires a newly frozen prospective identity and bound under the continuing direct repair authorization.

Never relabel old captures with newer source identities. r05 HTTP503/UNAVAILABLE, complete error bytes, one reservation and CLOSED status retained; no reinterpretation as free-tier evidence.
limitations: Up to five prospectively retained attempts cannot estimate general reliability or establish isolated causal improvement.
Passing declarations do not prove hidden provider source-use, independent authenticity, custody admission or external-world fee.
Paid API-credit instruction retained; fingerprint binding does not independently establish billing status.
Reserved cost is accounting, not independent provider billing.
Priority is a provider scheduling service. It may downgrade to standard and cannot guarantee every request succeeds.

pricing.reservation_formula: 200000*1.35/1000000 + 32768*6.75/1000000 = USD 0.491184; reservation is not an independently verified bill

observations: usageMetadata.serviceTier in retained raw response body
tier_scoring.acceptance: At least one recognized priority report and no conflicting, unknown or unspecified report. A body report is independently decoded locally; the server-retained header remains a server observation. Internal scheduling and billing are not independently verified.
tier_scoring.downgrade: Provider reports standard: retain complete answer and score it separately; Priority condition ROUTING_HOLD. No fallback request or retry.
tier_scoring.missing_or_conflicting: ROUTING_HOLD; retain raw provider bytes and any complete answer.
